title: a red ticket commits in the commons from inside cairn's pre-commit hook
intention: The tester's red-ticket commit runs its git in the commons with the commons' own index and object store, even when the reseal that cast the ticket runs inside cairn's pre-commit hook, so a red the reseal measured is ticketed instead of refused.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on akiendelllinux: during the 0c2c3f53c2be walk the reseal inside cairn's pre-commit hook raised RedTicketRefused twice, 'git diff --cached in /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons: fatal: unable to read 94b599b2c33fdbefc027c926bf780f341831efed'. 94b599b2 is cairn's README.md blob (git -C cairn ls-files -s), absent from the commons. The hook exports GIT_INDEX_FILE for cairn's index, and red_tickets._git spawns git -C <commons> inheriting it, so the commons is read through cairn's index. Every red measured by a hook-run reseal goes unticketed; trouble tester-reseal-could-not-run stands.
traces_to: Law 7 (errors are loud and permanent in records of truth: a measured red must reach its ticket); Law 3 (the reseal's measurement is lost when its record cannot be written).
how: In cairn/devices/tester/red_tickets.py, _git passes env=cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.git_env() (scratch.py:143, the settled scrub of GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE, GIT_PREFIX, GIT_COMMON_DIR, GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY, GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES), so `git -C <commons>` locates the commons' own repo; every _git caller targets the commons top. The red-first proof builds a scratch cairn repo and commons repo, exports GIT_INDEX_FILE at cairn's index, and runs the real _git against the commons.

clauses.claim: with GIT_INDEX_FILE exported at a scratch cairn repo's index, red_tickets._git ls-files against a scratch commons lists the commons' files, never cairn's
the environment red_tickets._git hands subprocess.run carries none of the repository-locating GIT_* variables

decisions.text: D1: red_tickets._git passes env=scratch.git_env(), the one settled scrub (Law 1: no new tuple); its docstring records the 94b599b2 mechanism.
D2: a NEW proof file (the 207c proof is untouched), one tooth per clause.
